title: justify-content on Wrong Axis
margin: auto Only on Block Elements

bugs.explanation: `margin: 0 auto` centres a block-level element horizontally, but `<span>` is inline by default. An inline element ignores `margin: auto` and explicit `width`. Change the element to a block element (`<div>`) or add `display: block` to the CSS to make centering work.

An `position: absolute` element is placed relative to the nearest ancestor with `position` other than `static`. Without a positioned parent, it falls back to the `<body>`, likely producing unexpected placement. The parent container should have `position: relative`.

title: Specificity Order Matters

bugs.explanation: `text-overflow: ellipsis` only works when three conditions are met together: the element has a fixed width, `overflow: hidden` (to hide the overflowing text), and `white-space: nowrap` (to prevent text from wrapping). Without the other two, the ellipsis has no effect.

title: vh Units on Mobile Ignore Browser Chrome

bugs.explanation: On mobile browsers, `100vh` includes the address bar height, which causes the hero section to be taller than the visible area — content gets hidden behind the browser UI. Use `100dvh` (dynamic viewport height) which adjusts when the browser chrome appears/disappears. Fall back to `100vh` for older browsers.

`z-index` only works on positioned elements (`position` not `static`). An element without a `position` declaration ignores `z-index`. Add `position: fixed` (or `absolute`/`relative`) to create the stacking context required for `z-index` to take effect.
